hypothesis: Switching a hidden successful-future constraint induces the registered policy-free reachability geometry in a meta-GRU and a matched low-rank transport of that deformation selectively changes behavior.

controls.description: Constraints A, B, and D each contain exactly 648 accept and 648 reject units under identical observation, feedback, timing, and magnitude schedules.
A randomized-label sham must remain at chance while all three deterministic rules are learned above their registered competence thresholds.
A known reachability geometry is injected into held-out representations to verify that the registered residualized crossnobis analysis can recover it.
Both A-to-B and B-to-A swaps are adjusted by matched no-swap drift under identical observation clocks.
Targeted rank-four transports must beat anchor-permuted and sixteen rank-, norm-, and covariance-matched random controls while preserving nuisance competence.
All confirmatory gates must transfer without refitting from the 6 by 6 torus to an untouched 7 by 7 cylinder.

gates.criterion: Schedules and action marginals match exactly; reachability RDMs are non-collinear; nuisance design is full rank with VIF below 10; and transport calibration and test units are disjoint.
A and B mean accuracy is at least 0.85 with at least 28 of 32 seeds above 0.80; D is at least 0.75; sham is at most 0.60; and the one-sided lower bound for injected-geometry lift exceeds 0.20.
Both active-minus-inactive constraint-specific reachability-alignment one-sided lower bounds exceed 0.05.
Both counterbalanced swap-effect one-sided lower bounds exceed 0.05 and no-swap drift remains below 0.05.
Both targeted undo transports selectively impair active behavior beyond all matched controls while satisfying decoding, norm, covariance, and dose-response bounds.
Both targeted impose transports selectively rescue compatible early-swap behavior beyond all matched controls while satisfying decoding, norm, covariance, and dose-response bounds.
F1 through G4 pass without refitting on the untouched cylinder topology.
